picks.name: Severed Heads
picks.bio: Australian experimental/industrial pioneers. "Cuisine (With Piscatorial)" (August 7, 2026) is an expanded reissue of their 1991 opus -- its first-ever vinyl pressing, on 2xLP, with a previously unreleased early version of "Seven of Oceans" included.
picks.why_listen: Genuinely new-to-the-world material from a foundational act -- the unreleased track alone makes it worth a listen for anyone into the industrial/experimental lineage behind a lot of modern club music.

picks.name: Sam Goku
picks.source_note: New release on Rhythm Section International.
picks.bio: Also known from releases on Dekmantel and Permanent Vacation. "Interrelation" (July 10, 2026) is his Rhythm Section International debut -- four tracks (Interrelation, Lilies Under The Moonlight, Sky and Sand (Club Mix), Leichte Glocken) spanning 96-133 BPM, exploring the buoyant dynamics of the club.
picks.why_listen: Deeply atmospheric house with real dancefloor punch and a wide tempo range in one EP -- flexible material for different moments in a set.

picks.name: Michelle
picks.source_note: New release on Kalahari Oyster Cult.
picks.bio: Kalahari Oyster Cult debutant out of Uruguay. "Unfailing Love" (July 31, 2026) is a four-track EP -- More Sexy Than Me, Is It Me?, Non Notes, Open The Door -- and the label's 80th release, described as "boisterous stuff."
picks.why_listen: A fresh name on a label worth watching -- boisterous, energetic house/techno good for building momentum in a set.
